title.narrative: Macroeconomic Emergency Programme to Protect Economic and Social Progress
Programa Macroeconmico de Emergencia para Proteger el Avance Econmico y Social

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es apoyar la accin del gobierno para (i) restablecer la estabilidad macroeconmica; (ii) tomar medidas deajuste fiscal para fomentar un equilibrio fiscal sostenible a corto y a mediano plazo; y (iii) proteger el gasto social para salvaguardarlos avances sociales realizados. La estructura y el contenido del programa concuerdan con el Servicio Ampliado del FMI (SAF), quefue aprobado recientemente.El programa est estructurado como prstamo de financiamiento especial para el desarrollo con una sola operacin que sedesembolsar en un solo tramo

The objective of the programme is to support the government's efforts to:(i) regain macroeconomic stability; (ii) implement fiscal adjustment measures that foster a sustainable fiscal balance in the short and medium term; and (iii) protect social spending to safeguard social gains achieved. The structure and content of the programme are aligned to the recently approved International Monetary Fund (IMF)Extended Fund Facility (EFF).The programme is structured as a Special Developing Lending with a single operation that will disburse in a single tranche.
